title: Context Utilization Policy
description: Which capsule sections count as required evidence, and what a receipt must carry before a utilization number is reportable. The version here is a cache-key dimension: changing any rule changes the verdict a capsule receives without changing the capsule, so entries cached under an older policy must not be served.

version.description: Bumped in the same commit as any rule change. Carried in the cache key.

requiredSections.description: Sections whose items are required evidence. A required item is never dropped to fit a token target; the refusal is context_budget_insufficient plus an expansion request.

optionalSections.description: Sections whose items may be dropped to fit a budget, recorded rather than silent.

requireExecutionBeforeRatio.description: A capsule compiled and never executed reports notExecuted, never a zero ratio. Utilization is a property of having been used, not of having been built.

unavailableIsNotZero.description: An unobservable cost is recorded as unavailable with a reason, never as 0. A measured zero may be summed; an unavailable one must stop a cheap-success claim.

measuredFieldsNameTheirProducer.description: Every measured field names the component that observed it, and never the accounting module, which records numbers rather than observing them.
